properties.notes: Site of an existing three-storey care home within the centre of Ponteland. This currently provides 35 bedsits and 1-bed flats for elderly persons but has been identified for clearance, with redevelopment of a new facility intended to follow. Part of a scheme to renew social housing stock and provide more fitting accommodation. An application is currently pending for demolition of the existing building and replacement with a new care home of 34 units (19/01223/FUL). The proposed residential units are self-contained flats (C3) for elderly persons, and so constitute as individual dwellings and 34 net gains to the housing stock. If the current application is permitted, the deliverability of development will be reappraised.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
